caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stage or frame structure with two vertical red columns on either side and a matching red horizontal beam along the top, which is adorned with leaf-shaped ornaments and two finials that resemble stylized flames or leaves inside circles at each upper corner. At the bottom of the frame is a thick, horizontal brown beam supported by short vertical legs, giving the appearance of a wooden platform or shelf. Within the frame, there is a scene consisting of two pale brown trees with blue leaves and five small human figures, colored mainly in shades of red and brown, standing among the trees. Above the central scene, the inner upper border of the frame is decorated with small red flower or leaf motifs evenly spaced along a light background. The outer area of the drawing is left blank, with the artist’s signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” written in the lower right quadrant. Blue and red gear or flower-like shapes flank either side of the main structure, connected by thin lines. The composition uses primarily red, brown, blue, and light beige tones.
title: Restoration Drawing: Wall Decoration Over Doorway in Mission House
